name: Comic book
when: A playful feature announcement or a problem-and-fix story told in a few panels: a new feature, a before and after, a customer's bad day turned good.
look: Comic panels with thick black borders and halftone shading, bold primary colours, speech bubbles and sound-effect bursts in comic lettering
pace: Panel by panel: the camera moves into each panel for 3-4 s, sound effects stamp on the beat, then a pull back to the whole page
